# Explorer a Hunter: odložené produkční linky

Při zapojení výstavby přes Base Camp zůstávají Explorer a Hunter dočasně bez produkčních linek. Hledání zvířat a lov budou navrženy v samostatném kroku. Tato poznámka uchovává původní konfigurace před jejich odebráním; nejde o schválený návrh budoucí produkce.

Zdrojová revize projektu: 1789769509197. Ostatní vlastnosti obou itemů mají zůstat beze změny.

## Explorer / game

Původní line v kanonickém JSON:

{"id":"game","title":"Game","description":"Try to find something to eat. Or something that will eat you","default":true,"show":true,"enable":false,"runtimeMs":20000,"input":[{"type":"simple"}],"output":{"set":[{"weight":1,"rules":[],"roll":[{"type":"chance","chance":0.65,"drop":[{"itemId":"fawn","quantity":{"min":1,"max":1},"placement":"drop","rules":[]}]},{"type":"chance","chance":0.5,"drop":[{"itemId":"wild-boar","quantity":{"min":1,"max":1},"placement":"drop","rules":[]}]},{"type":"chance","chance":0.35,"drop":[{"itemId":"bear","quantity":{"min":1,"max":1},"placement":"drop","rules":[]}]}]}]},"rules":[{"hint":"You need forest next to explorer to find some game","when":[{"query":{"selector":{"type":"item","itemId":"forest"},"scope":"board","distance":"close"},"type":"exists"}],"type":"enable"}]}

## Hunter / hunt-bear

Původní line nemá output. Je nutné ho navrhnout před opětovným zapojením lovu.

{"id":"hunt-bear","title":"Hunt a Bear","description":"If you don't like bears, you can hunt it down","default":false,"show":false,"enable":true,"runtimeMs":45000,"input":[{"type":"materials","selector":{"type":"item","itemId":"arrows"},"mode":"consume","quantity":{"min":1,"max":1}},{"type":"materials","selector":{"type":"item","itemId":"bear"},"mode":"consume","quantity":{"min":1,"max":1}},{"type":"materials","selector":{"type":"item","itemId":"bow"},"mode":"reserve","quantity":{"min":1,"max":1}}],"rules":[{"hint":"No bear no hunt","when":[{"query":{"selector":{"type":"item","itemId":"bear"},"scope":"board","distance":"far"},"type":"exists"}],"type":"show"}]}
